about:
# Auctionator Effects

Search auctions by tooltip text, from the Buy or Shopping tab.

```
sword #magical spells
#healing #spirit
"Sword of Decay" #nature
```

- `#text` after the name keeps only items whose tooltip contains that text.
- Several `#` = all must match.
- Works with shopping lists and the advanced search fields (put `#` in the name).

A `#` search on the Buy tab opens in Shopping (same category and levels), where the filter runs. Needs Auctionator.

Debug: `/aeffects` (prints each checked item).

Tests: `lua5.1 tests/test_logic.lua`

## First release

- Several `#` = all must match. Needs Auctionator.
